description.value: JM7 Bakery is a family-owned Filipino bakery in Surrey's Whalley neighbourhood, specializing in traditional baked goods such as pandesal, ube loaf, hopia, and pan de coco. The business traces its roots to Concepcion, Iloilo, Philippines in 1973 and has been baking in BC since 2007, now nearly 20 years under Master Baker Nanay Mila. Touring cyclists will find a range of affordable, carb-dense baked goods well-suited for refuelling on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at jm-7-bakery.square.site confirms the business is actively operating with a live online ordering system and a full product menu. The OSM address (10059 Whalley Boulevard, Surrey) is corroborated by the website (10059 Whalley Blvd, Surrey, BC V3T 4G1), which also supplies a phone number and postal code absent from OSM. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields are null.
concerns: Website URL was machine-discovered with medium confidence and is not present in OSM tags; the Square site title uses 'JM-7 Bakery' (hyphenated) while OSM records it as 'JM7 Bakery'.
OSM category is 'Groceries' but the business is a specialty Filipino bakery selling baked goods only — no general grocery staples confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible specialty bakery confirmed via an active Square ordering site. A practical stop for touring cyclists seeking affordable, carb-rich food.
